summary: Prudential plc furnished a 6-K attaching a UK TR-1 major-holdings notification disclosing UBS Group AG's aggregate position crossing 5% on 11-Sep-2026, reported 15-Sep-2026. UBS holds 124,947,129 direct voting rights (5.0123%) plus 0.1062% via instruments, totaling 5.1185% (127,595,234 votes), versus 0.000% previously. Instruments include depositary receipts, call options expiring 14-Dec-2026 to 18-Jun-2027, physical short puts, cash equity swaps, basket swaps through 2030 and a reverse convertible. This is a passive disclosure filing, not an activist campaign, tender or offer; no board recommendation, advisor, price or premium. Watch whether UBS's derivative and swap positions translate into economic or voting influence, or signal stake-building ahead of any corporate action.
